title: Gratia Vocabulary — Instruction Set Interface
description: Atomic verbs for human state processing. Each verb is an ISA opcode — pure intent, no runtime.

moods.description: All recognized human states. Used by adapters for auto-detection.

verb.description: An atomic verb — a single, deterministic action on human state. This is the ISA definition only.

id.description: Unique identifier. Used in patterns, contraindications, and adapter contracts.

category.description: Where the action happens. interior = internal state, exterior = output/action, social = between people

description.description: What this verb does. Written for both humans and systems.

effects.description: What happens when this verb executes. Adapters MUST apply all effects.

next_verb_suggestions.description: Recommended verbs to call after this one. Forms natural verb sequences.

contraindications.description: Verbs that should NOT be called immediately before or after this one.

param.description: A single parameter definition. Follows JSON Schema Draft 2020-12.

description.description: What this parameter means. Shown to the system as guidance.

enum.description: Allowed values. Used for constrained parameters.

default.description: Default value if not provided by the user.

effect.description: A single effect that occurs when a verb executes. Adapters MUST apply all declared effects.

target.description: What is affected. Examples: mood, cognitive_load, energy, workspace

direction.description: Direction of change (for directional effects like cognitive_load) or new state (for perspective shifts).
